name: Pavitr Prabhakar
distinction: A Spider-Man based in Mumbattan in the films and in the Spider-Man: India comics. He is not Peter Parker.
summary: Pavitr Prabhakar is Spider-Man India. The 2004 comic miniseries introduced him. Karan Soni voices a film version in Across the Spider-Verse.
creators: Sharad Devarajan, Suresh Seetharaman, and Jeevan J. Kang.
